subject: general
question: As per Renewable Fuel Association data, ______ was the world's largest producer of ethanol in the year 2020.
solution:
The correct answer is__** The United States of America.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to **Renewable Fuel Association (RFA) data** 2020, The United States is the world's largest producer of ethanol, having produced over **13.94 billion** gallons followed by **Brazil at 8.08 ****billion** gallons in 2020.
 
• Together, the United States and Brazil produce **82% of the world's ethanol.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ethanol **can be produced from **sugarcane, maize, wheat, etc which are having high starch content.**
 
• **In India,** ethanol is mainly produced from **sugarcane molasses by the fermentation process.**
 
• Ethanol can be mixed with the gasoline to form different blends.
 
• As the ethanol molecule contains oxygen, it allows the engine to completely combust the fuel, resulting in fewer emissions and thereby **reducing the occurrence of environmental pollution.**
 
• Since ethanol is produced from plants that harness the power of the sun, ethanol is also considered a **renewable fuel.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **The government of India** has been promoting the use of ethanol as a blendstock with main automotive fuels like petrol in line with the **National Policy on Biofuels (NBP) -2018 under the Ethanol Blended Petrol (EBP) Program.**
 
• This policy envisages an indicative target of blending** ****20 per cent ethanol in petrol by 5 years to 2025-26.**
